name: Copycat Recipe
source:
Marley, copyeditor to popular hypnosis content creator RhymingWithoutReason, is at her wits' end. But as her highest paying client, she has little choice but to stick with it. Anny, a suspiciously peppy woman who's a fan of Marley's own creative endeavors, is an added ingredient to the mix. Will she be the spice to Marley's life, or are they cooked?

[From [url=https://hyp-hyp-hooray.itch.io/copycat-recipe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
马利是流行催眠内容创作者RhymingWithoutReason的文案编辑，她已经无计可施了。但作为她报酬最高的客户，她别无选择，只能坚持下去。安妮是一个令人怀疑的活泼女人，她是马利自己的创意事业的粉丝，是这个组合中的一个补充成分。她会成为马利生活的调味品，还是他们已经熟了？

[来自[url=https://hyp-hyp-hooray.itch.io/copycat-recipe]itch.io[/url]]
